articles.summary: St. Louis, MO (May 18, 2026) As rising rent prices and housing market uncertainty continue to challenge many first-time homebuyers, mortgage experts say misconceptions about credit scores and interest rates may be preventing buyers from exploring homeownership opportunities. According to Zillow , median rents for single-family homes have increased approximately 30% to 45% in many markets since early 2020. With monthly rent payments in many areas now rivaling or even exceeding the cost of a mortgage, Kristi Amenda, AVP, Mortgage Loan Officer at First Mid Bank Trust, is encouraging people to view homeownership as a smart long-term investment. People are often surprised to learn they may already be paying more in rent than they would for a mortgage, said Amenda. articles.title: First Mid Bank & Trust Encourages Buyers to Explore Homeownership Amid Rising Rent Costs

articles.summary: Burlington, IA (May 11, 2026) First Mid Wealth Management, a division of First Mid Bancshares, Inc. and a branch office of Raymond James, announces that Financial Advisor Kyle Wagenbach has joined its team. Wagenbach brings a unique and analytical perspective to financial planning, drawing on a diverse background in engineering, economics, entrepreneurship, and agriculture. He specializes in long-term investment strategies and risk management, developing customized solutions tailored to each clients unique objectives. We are thrilled to welcome Kyle to our team, said Eric Benne, SVP, Director of Trust at First Mid Wealth Management. His commitment to client-first service, combined with his diverse background, strengthens our ability to deliver thoughtful, personalized financial strategies.
